outcome: Long-term medical outcomes (medical problems, surgical procedures, work-related issues, pregnancy outcomes, psychiatric interventions, willingness to donate again, mortality)
cohort: 698 living liver donors who underwent donor hepatectomy between 2012 and 2018
finding: Living liver donors generally experience a promising long-term outlook, although quality of life parameters may decline over time.
mod_finding: Females were more likely to have undergone incisional hernia repair after donation compared to males.
